label: scenario
evidence: In commit 7efc1569111058530a119c31a1c49cb1fb6e923f, buildOfficeSnapshot only retired runs older than DAY_MS if status was complete or failed (!['complete', 'failed'].includes(run.status)). Runs in other inactive states such as paused, stopping, blocked, or budget-limited bypassed the retention window and lingered indefinitely until fixed to retire all non-active runs after the retention period.
cue: When filtering or retiring runs in snapshot views based on their lifecycle status and a retention window.
check: Does the retention filter retire all inactive, halted, or non-progressing states (such as paused, stopping, blocked, and budget-limited) after the retention window rather than only complete or failed runs?
